name: 一体成型双穿凉拖鞋款
description: 一体成型轻量鞋身、后跟带前后两穿、通勤一脚蹬成双交付

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF sweep for packshots, matte #EFEDE9 panel for benefit and close shots, one real outdoor asphalt scene, no gradients
styleLock.lightingSystem: high-key studio light from a front-left broad source with a #FFFFFF bounce card, soft single-direction contact shadows, hard daylight only in the one lifestyle shot
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless studio sweep and matte neutral boards #EFEDE9 / #EAE6E0 / #CFCCC6, real cracked asphalt for the street shot
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for post-production; no in-image copy rendered by the model
styleLock.presentationRules: one single unit for flanks and macro, matched pairs for overhead and closing shots, product always resting on its outsole with a grounded contact shadow, consistent scale across the set
noDrift: no background gradients or tinted sweeps
no inconsistent lighting direction between shots
no rendered text, numbers or arrows inside the image
no brand wordmarks, embossed lettering or round pivot badges
no floating product without a contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean monochrome footwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless #FFFFFF sweep, matte #EFEDE9 neutral panel, graphite product tone #1B1B1D and one stone-grey secondary accent #A6A29C; neutral high-key studio lighting with a broad front-left key, a #FFFFFF bounce card on the shadow side and soft single-direction contact shadows; matte neutral boards #EFEDE9 / #EAE6E0 / #CFCCC6 as surfaces, one real asphalt lifestyle scene; modern geometric sans-serif reserved for post-production only, no rendered text inside the image; no icons or badges; stable product scale with the product resting on its outsole; no color palette changes, no background gradients, no inconsistent lighting, no in-image text, no wordmarks or badges, no floating product.

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里用一整圈干净侧影赢下一眼点击，产品轮廓不被任何元素干扰。
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile at eye level, single unit resting on its outsole, toe pointing left, full silhouette inside the crop
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, broad front-left key with a #FFFFFF bounce card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow under the outsole
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, even margin only around the silhouette
shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One single unit resting on its outsole in a clean 90-degree side profile at eye level, toe pointing left, full silhouette visible with nothing clipped by the frame edges. Bright even high-key studio light from a broad front-left key with a #FFFFFF bounce card on the shadow side, one soft contact shadow directly under the outsole. Seamless #FFFFFF studio sweep background. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame and no extra whitespace is reserved. Negative: no props, no hands, no feet or legs, no embossed wordmark, no round pivot-badge artwork, no decorative charm shapes, no in-image text, no gradient background, no hard cast shadow, no cropped toe or heel, no duplicated sole layers, no floating product.

shots.intent: 一秒讲清核心利益：同一只鞋后跟带前放与后翻即是两种穿法。
shots.camera: straight-on view 15 degrees above the surface, two identical units side by side on one ground line
shots.lighting: soft front key with gentle fill, matched soft contact shadows under both units
shots.whitespace: generous clean negative space across the top quarter of the frame
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two identical units side by side on one shared ground line, photographed straight-on from 15 degrees above the surface: the left unit with its heel strap swung forward and seated behind the heel, the right unit with the same strap folded back flat against the instep, so the two wear positions read at a glance. Soft front key light with gentle fill, matched soft contact shadows under both units, identical light direction on both. Matte #EFEDE9 seamless panel background. The pair occupies 50-60% of the frame, generous clean negative space across the top 25% of the frame. Negative: no text, no arrows, no icons, no numbered steps, no wordmark or round badge graphics, no hands, no feet, no mismatched lighting or scale between the two units, no extra props, no gradient background.

shots.intent: 让买家把自己代入夏日上街与通勤的真实步伐里，完成自我投射。
shots.camera: low camera at ankle height, straight-on to the walking stride, body cropped above the knees
shots.lighting: hard midday daylight from the upper right at 5600K, long crisp shadow on the road, slight motion blur on the rear foot
shots.background: real junction asphalt #5F5B58 with faded #F2F1EF painted crossing stripes, blurred storefronts far behind
shots.props: light cotton crew socks in #F7F6F3, nothing else
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the street fills the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle street scene: {product} worn on real feet mid-stride across a sunlit city junction. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera low at ankle height, straight-on to the walking stride, the two shoes large in the lower half of the frame and the body cropped above the knees so no face is visible. Hard midday daylight from the upper right at 5600K casting one long crisp shadow on the road, slight motion blur on the trailing foot, candid handheld framing that is off-center on purpose. Ground is cracked asphalt #5F5B58 with faded #F2F1EF painted crossing stripes, distant storefronts thrown out of focus. Crew socks in #F7F6F3. The footwear occupies 40-50% of the frame and no extra whitespace is reserved. Negative: no identifiable face, no readable signage lettering, no street signs or license plates with legible text, no brand marks or charm shapes on the shoe, no other pedestrians in focus, no text overlay, no watermark, no over-smoothed skin, no other product appearing twice, no mismatched shadow directions.

shots.intent: 用左右两栏同机位对照，一次讲清两只外翼与内翼的结构差异，消除看图死角。
shots.camera: matched straight-on 90-degree side profiles, one flank per panel, mirrored to face the same direction
shots.lighting: identical even high-key front-left light and identical soft contact shadow on both panels
shots.background: seamless #F2F1EF on both panels, hairline #E2E0DB seam between them
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace inside either panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison screen, two matched panels with identical framing, distance and light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. {product} appears once per panel: the left panel shows the outer flank of the unit in a clean 90-degree side profile, the right panel shows the inner flank of the same unit mirrored to the same side profile, both resting on the same ground line. Even high-key front-left studio light with a #FFFFFF bounce card, one identical soft contact shadow on each panel. Seamless #F2F1EF background on both panels divided by a hairline #E2E0DB seam. Each unit occupies 35-40% of its panel and no extra whitespace sits inside either panel. Negative: no tick or cross symbols, no winner marks, no arrows, no text, no numbers, no invented claims, no second brand product implied, no wordmark or pivot-badge graphics, no mismatched scale or light between the two panels, no duplicated shoe inside one panel.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001/011＝同款单只在近白无缝背景上的正侧 90 度侧影，后跟带向后翻起；002/007＝后跟正视图，可见跨带与内底；003/008＝90 度俯打成双摆放，鞋面开孔阵列与内底条状纹、侧沿石纹灰；004＝超宽横幅的另一侧内翼侧影；009＝内翼侧影方图；005＝真实街口斑马线通勤场景，硬日光长投影、胶片感手持、鞋面挂了装饰扣、背景有店铺招牌与路牌文字；006＝高 3/4 后侧角展示内腔；010＝一双 3/4 前视，两只后跟带一前一后呈两种穿法。其中 007 与 002、008 与 003、011 与 001 近似重复，合并同类角色后成 9 镜（不足半数，套组成立，非色卡变体画廊：11 张同为单一颜色同一款的分角度棚拍加一张实景）。品类判定依据：图为成人上脚的一体成型发泡凉拖鞋、带可前放后翻的后跟带，按图归「鞋靴/凉拖鞋」，不采信源平台类目字符串；productFamily 取 fashion。已剥离内容：源品牌字、后跟跨带上的浮雕字标、踝部圆形铆钉徽标图样、鞋面装饰扣图案、街景店铺招牌与路牌文字、模特面容与身份（模版改为膝上裁切、不露脸）、以及鞋面开孔的具体排布造型（属源款商标特征，模版只写通用一体成型凉拖鞋形态，造型细节交给 {product_identity_lock}）。全套不含任何数值、尺码表、检测与资质主张，收口与信任镜均留空白区供后期。
